method: Isolated offscreen Quickshell fixtures copy actual source components, assets and Geometry; fake resolved Core.Theme; temporary XDG_CONFIG_HOME. Installed shell is untouched. Pill fixture extracts actual shoulder Shape and body geometry declarations; excludes HoverHandler and content lifecycle.

pureModel.coverage: historical default metrics/roles; content growth; capsule and concentric inset; bounded tiny fills; preferred pixel alignment; scales 0.5/1/1.25/2, fonts 10/13/20, DPR 1/1.25/2/3; invalid dimensions and unknown roles

interpretation: Default zero/tiny/half/full checked focused control renders are pixel identical. Bounded tiny-fill radii correct explicit properties Qt previously clamped visually.

The existing checked switch thumb endpoint x=27 is calibrated and preserved, including its historical 1px right inset. Thumb radius follows the circular track-radius-minus-vertical-inset formula; the historical horizontal checked offset is retained.
At explicit button font20, preferred height grows38 to43; narrow large-font capture differs 2158 pixels. This content growth is intentional.
All six isolated actual Pill silhouette captures are pixel identical at default inputs.
limitations: Offscreen renderer checks do not prove live compositor appearance, screen-frame attachment, reservations, input masks, pointer/focus lifecycle or animations.
Pill source geometry is extracted and rendered without its live PanelWindow, system services, contents or lifecycle.
Scaled fixture verifies finite nonnegative extents and bounded radii, no QML errors/binding loops; it does not claim all long labels or all product widths fit.
Pure checks cover sampled scale/font/DPR combinations; integration uses default DPR1 and fractional DPR1.25 only.

existingIntegrationChecks.coverage: capsule pointer/drag/keyboard, square power cards at default/narrow widths, disabled controls, mock dispatch, focus restoration, theme/audio actions, content heights; added scale1.25/font20 minimum-cell power reflow
real calendar components, modes, editor, preference sharing, constrained scrolling
routing, search, preferences, audio/themes, compact/wide navigation, retry, close/reopen

staticChecks.qmllint: Core/shared controls checked. Existing delegate/property warnings; Pill/ScreenBorder metadata reports uncreatable PanelWindow/unresolved margins and QuickSettings BluetoothAdapter warnings. Static lint alone does not establish runtime PanelWindow behavior.
